title: FARL: Use Factor-Augmented Regularized Latent Regression for Large-Scale Assessment
text: FARL package implements factor-augmented regularized latent regression (FARLR) large-scale assessments. FARLR addresses high-dimensional, strongly dependent background variables separating common variation covariate-specific information. Common-factor scores enter latent regression, sparse regularization identifies smaller set additional background variables associated achievement. multidimensional assessments, MFARLR extends strategy several correlated latent traits. estimates regression coefficients full residual covariance jointly. preserves dependence among dimensions plausible values generated population subgroup analyses. package supports: unidimensional FARLR estimation Farlr_mml(); unidimensional PCA-based DIRE estimation Dire_mml(); multidimensional FARLR-GVEM estimation MFARLR_mml(); multidimensional DIRE estimation MDIRE_mml(); plausible-value generation fitted models. vignette first presents unidimensional workflow multidimensional workflow. emphasis preparing data, fitting models, interpreting returned objects, generating plausible values, conducting secondary analyses rather mathematical derivations.

title: FARL: Use Factor-Augmented Regularized Latent Regression for Large-Scale Assessment
text: MFARLR uses three steps. First, factor analysis summarizes common variation standardized covariates. Second, FARLR_Debias screens covariates within latent dimension records dimension-specific selection pattern. Third, selected positions held fixed GVEM jointly updates coefficient matrix, person-specific variational moments, full latent residual covariance. Gaussian variational posterior makes updates computationally feasible without multidimensional quadrature.

what: FARL: Use Factor-Augmented Regularized Latent Regression for Large-Scale Assessment
title: FARL: Use Factor-Augmented Regularized Latent Regression for Large-Scale Assessment
text: FARL implements factor-augmented regularized latent regression (FARLR) large-scale assessments. FARLR addresses high-dimensional, strongly dependent background variables decomposing variation common latent factors idiosyncratic components. components enter latent regression, sparse regularization selects parsimonious set relevant covariates. structure stabilizes estimation, preserves interpretability selected background variables, supports plausible-value generation group-level inference. multidimensional assessments, FARL jointly estimates regression coefficient matrix full latent residual covariance Gaussian variational expectation-maximization. Farlr_mml(): Provides unified interface fitting FARLR models. Use method = "FARLR_EMM" importance-sampling-based expectation-maximization-maximization estimation, method = "FARLR_Debias" correct shrinkage bias regularized coefficients. Farlr_drawPVs(): Draws plausible values posterior latent-trait distributions implied fitted FARLR model. Dire_mml(): Fits PCA-based DIRE latent regression used comparison approach high-dimensional background variables. Dire_drawPVs(): Draws plausible values fitted DIRE models. MFARLR_mml(): Fits multidimensional FARLR combining dimension-specific sparse screening joint GVEM estimation. MFARLR_drawPVs(): Draws correlated multidimensional plausible values fitted MFARLR model. MDIRE_mml() MDIRE_drawPVs(): Fit multidimensional PCA-based comparison model generate plausible values.

Item parameter table containing least columns slope, difficulty, guessin, used define item response model. n_sam Integer. Number Monte Carlo samples per individual used approximate integrals latent traits. Defaults 5. method Character string. Estimation method used. Supported values include: "FARLR_EMM" Iterative FARLR estimation based EM–M–type   updating scheme regularization. "FARLR_Debias" FARLR estimation regularized variable   selection followed post-selection debiased refit. Defaults "FARLR_EMM". lambda Numeric vector. Candidate regularization parameters used penalized regression. Defaults seq(0.1, 0.5, = 0.1). delta.criteria Numeric. Convergence tolerance iterative updates. Defaults 1e-3. iter.max Integer.
